title: Support Plan Audit
description: Complete 10% of Service User's file per month
comments: Complete 10% of Service User's file per month

checklist.text: Is there evidence of a robust pre-admission assessment?
If risks were identified at pre-admission assessment, were risk assessments in place prior to admission to the service?
Is there a One Page Profile in place?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Rights, Consent and Capacity?
Is there evidence that the Service User has been involved in the support plan?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is there evidence of an OPG100 search?
Are OPG100 search results evidenced in the support plan?
If an LPA is in place, is there clear evidence of input in the relevant support plans?
If an advocate is required, is there evidence that this a referral has been made if one is not already in place?
Is there evidence of how much financial support the service user needs and how and who provides this to them?
Are there financial forms in place to evidence who is responsbible for all financial aspects? (Rent, Service Charges, Bills, Personal Effects, Personal Allowance etc)
Is there evidence of what consent has been given in terms of information sharing?
Is the service user's social worker details recorded in the support plan?
Are there best interest forms in place where ever a service user is queried to lack capacity for individual areas?
If court of protection have been involved, is there evidence of the outcomes of this and is this reflected in the support plan?
If the service user is deemed to lack capacity in any area, following a best interests decision, has a DoLS been applied for?
Are DoLS results clearly documented?
If conditions have been applied, is there evidence that these are incorporated into the support plan?
If conditions have been applied, is there evidence that these are monitored at least once a month?
If there are restrictive Practices in place, is there a support plan in place to evidence this?
If restrictive practices are in place, is there evidence in place to outline the purpose, when to be utilised, how to be utilised and the least restrictive route?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Medication?
Has an assessment been carried out to assess the Service User's suitability to self medicate?
If the service user self medicates, is there a lockable cupboard available to them?
If the service user self medicates, is there evidence that these are checked weekly at a minimum (dependant on risk assessment)?
If the service user self medicates, is there evidence that a risk assessment is in place and incorporated into the support plan?
Is there evidence of the level of support that the service user requires around medication adminstration and management?
Is there a record of any allergies or adverse reactions to medication?
Is the service User's GP details included in the support plan?
Is there details of any other healthcare professionals or services involved in the service users care, including contact details and out of hours contacts?
Is the service user's preferred way of taking medicatiosn recorded?
Is there an upto date list of the service users current medications and what each medication is prescribed for?
If the service user is prescribed PRN medications, are there clear directions of when and why these are to be administered?
If the service user is on covert medications, are there clear directives around this?
If the service user is prescribed topical medications, is there a TMAR in place?
If the service user is prescribed CD's, is there a clear protocol outlined in the support plan?
Is there evidence that the service user has had their medications reviewed in the last 6 months?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Medical Diagnoses?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Has a transfer of care been obtained from the GP?
Is there a clear medical history available and any current medical conditions are documented?
Does the support plan outline all current medical conditions and how they are being managed?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify the needs around mobility?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is there evidence that any risks have been identified and clearly reflected in the support plan?
If any adaptive equipment is required, is there evidence that this is in place?
If any adaptive equipment is required, is there clear directive on how this is to be used, how many staff are required to support etc?
If the service user has pain that impacts mobility, is there directive in the support plan on the best way to minimise this?
If mobility is affected by environment, is this clearly planned for?
Does the support plan identify how many staff are required for all movements and mobility?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Fluid and Nutrition?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Are any allergies or intollerances clearly identified?
Are the service users likes and dislikes included in the support plan?
Is the support plan clear on the capabilities of the service user in regards to preparing meals, snack and drinks?
If the service user has any eating disorders, is there clear guidance on how this is monitored an managed and any external professionals involved?
Are risk assessments in place for using cookers, microwaves and kettles?
If there are any choke risks, are these risk assessed and incorporated into the support plan?
If a modified diet or fluid intake is required, are there clear IDDSI guidelines in place and SALT input?
Is there a plan around who completes shopping and when this is done?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Communication
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is the service user's preferred method of communication recorded?
Are the service user's levels of communication recorded and explained?
Is there clear direction on how to ensure effective communication?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Continence?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
If the service user is taking any medications that affect elimination, is this clearly outlined? (opiates, diuretics, laxatives etc)
If the service user requires any assistance with continence care, is this clearly documented?
Is the gender preference of the support worker documented?
If a Radar Key is required in public spaces, is this doumented as to where it is kept?
If the service user has, or is prone to, any conditions or illness that affect elimination, is there a clear plan around the management of this?
Does the plan outline how privacy and dignity will be respected?

If any continence devices are required (body  worn pads, stoma bags, catheters, convene's etc) is the support plan clear on how/when these are used, how much assistance is required and the type that is used?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Personal Care?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Are the service user's preferences made clear around frequency of bathing/showering?
Is the level of support needed from support staff made clear?
If assistance is required with cleansing and dressing, is the gender preference of the service user's support worker documented?
Does the support plan identify who is responsible for ensuring the service user has enough toiletries?
Does the support plan outline the service user's needs around changing clothing and how much assistance, if any, is needed?
Is there a plan around laundering clothing and ensuring the service user has clean clothes available?
Does the support plan identify who is responsible for new clothing when required?
Is there evidence that the service user's oral health needs are addressed and planned for, including regular dental appointments?
Does the support plan outline how privacy and dignity are to be protected?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Skin Integrity?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is there a body map oin place in the support plan?
Is there a WATERLOW in place in the support plan and the results reflected in the support plan?
If any pressure relieving equipment is required, is there documentation of whom provides this and the serial number of the equpment?
If the service user has any conditions, or takes any medications, that affect skin integrity, are these recorded in the support plan, along with direction on how to manage this?
If the service user is prescribed any topical medications, are these recorded in the support plan?
If the service user has a history of self harm, is there a plan around how any cuts etc are to be addressed?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Sleep?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Does the support plan evidence how much, if any, support is needed through the night?
Does the support plan identified the service users preferences around waking and sleeping times?
Are the service users preferences around bedroom conditions recorded?
If the service user is prescribed sedative medications, is this identified in the support plan?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Breathing?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
If the service user has any condition that affects breathing (Asthma, COPD, AF etc) is there a clear plan around any treatment that is required and the management of this?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Altered States of Conciousness?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
If there are any history of altered states of consciousness, is this recorded, along with a clear support plan?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Life History?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is there evidence to show that the life story has been put together with the service user and includes family and friend input where appropriate?
Does the support plan outline how life history is reflected into current views and needs?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Religion and Culture?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Are the service user's religious views clear?
Are the service user's spitual needs clear?
Is the plan reflective of any practices of the service user and how these are to be supported?
Is the Cultural aspect clear and reflected in the support plan?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Sexuality?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Are the service user's preferred pronouns recorded and known by staff members?
Is the service usuers sexual orientation recorded?
Is the service users level of understanding around consent well documented?
If the service user inappropriately self gratifies, is there guidance around discreet redirection?
Is there clear outlines on how privacy and dignity are met?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Psychological and Mental Health?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Are any conditions and/or diagnoses clearly identified in the support plan?
Does the support plan explain how any mental helath or psychological conditions impact on the service user's needs and identities?
Are any medications prescribed clearly documented with how they work and what they are for?
Is it clear how to identify when the service user needs increased support around their mental or psychological health needs and what that looks like for the service user?
Are known triggers included in the support plan?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Positive Behaviour Support?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is the support plan based around pre-emptive support rather than reactive?
Are known triggers included and guidance around minimising triggers?
Are clear de-escalation techniques included in the support plan?
Is there an escalation plan in place to ensure that the correct steps are taken at the correct times?
Does the support plan show least restrictive options?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Personal Relationships?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Does the support plan identify who is important to the service user?
Does the support plan outline negative realtionships that the service user may have?
Does the support plan identify how to build positive relationships?
Does the support plan identify where relationships may be chosen, despite being unhealthy?
Does the support plan identify how to build peer relationships?
Does the support plan outline how to support the service user if relationships break down?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Hobbies and Interests?
Is there evidence that goals have been identified and how these can be achieved?
Is there evidence to support the service user with maintaining and building upon hobbies and interests?
Does the support plan identify known past and current hobbies and interests and how to facilitate these?
Does the support plan identify how to engage the service user during periods of apathy?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Education and Employment?

Does the support plan identify what, if any, education or employment the service user wishes to achieve?
Is there evidence that there is a plan on how to support the person to attend work or education and what that would look like?
Is there evidence that the support plan is evaluated at least once a month or if there are changes?
Is there a support plan in place to identify needs around Smoking?

If the service user smokes, is there a robust risk assessment around this and the results reflected in the support plan?
Is there evidence that there is an approved location for the service user to smoke or vape?
If the service user wishes to quit, is there evidence of referral to a smoking cessation service?

A current Medication Policy is in place and reviewed within the last 12 months.
Staff have access to the Medication Policy and understand it.
There is a clear procedure for ordering, receiving, administering, and disposing of medication.
PRN protocols are in place, up to date, and person‑specific.
MAR charts are fully completed with no unexplained gaps.
MAR charts include allergies, GP details, and medication changes.
Handwritten MAR entries are double‑signed and dated.
PRN administration is recorded with reason and outcome.
MAR charts match the medication currently held in the service. (check the physical medications against the balance on the MAR)
Medication is ordered in a timely manner to avoid running out.
Medication received is checked against the order and MAR chart.
Any discrepancies are reported and recorded.
Medication is stored securely in a locked cupboard or cabinet.
Controlled Drugs (CDs) are stored in a compliant CD cabinet.
Room and fridge temperatures are recorded daily and within safe ranges.
Keys for medication storage are held only by authorised staff.
Staff follow the 5/7 Rights of Medication Administration.
Staff wash hands and follow IPC procedures before administering medication.
Medication is administered at the correct time and dose.
Staff ensure the person has taken the medication before signing.
Covert medication is only used with proper authorisation and documentation.
CD register is completed accurately and balances match stock.
Two staff sign for administration of CDs.
CD audits are completed weekly or as per policy.
Medication errors are reported immediately and recorded.
Investigations are completed and learning outcomes documented.
Staff receive feedback and retraining where required.
Medication for disposal is stored securely until collection.
Returns are recorded and signed by staff.
Controlled Drugs disposal follows legal requirements.
All staff administering medication have up‑to‑date medication training.
Staff have completed competency assessments.
Agency staff are not permitted to administer medication unless authorised.
Support plans include clear medication needs and preferences.
Capacity assessments are completed for medication decisions where required.
Best‑interest decisions are documented if the person lacks capacity.

title: Accidents, Incidents and Near Misses Audit

title: COSHH Audit
description: Chemical safety data sheets, storage, PPE
comments: Chemical safety data sheets, storage, PPE

checklist.text: Is there an up‑to‑date COSHH policy in place?
Is the COSHH policy accessible to all staff?
Have all staff received COSHH awareness training?
Are refresher training sessions completed annually?
Is there a complete and current list of all hazardous substances on site?
Are all substances stored in their original containers?
Are all containers clearly labelled and legible?
Are any expired or unnecessary substances removed promptly?
Are Safety Data Sheets available for every hazardous substance?
Are Safety Data Sheets stored in an accessible location for staff?
Are Safety Data Sheets reviewed annually or when products change?
Are COSHH risk assessments completed for all hazardous substances?
Are risk assessments reviewed annually or after an incident?
Do risk assessments identify exposure routes (skin, inhalation, ingestion)?
Do risk assessments include control measures and PPE requirements?
Are hazardous substances stored securely and away from service users?
Are cleaning chemicals stored in a locked cupboard?
Are flammable substances stored appropriately?
Are incompatible substances stored separately?
Are staff following manufacturer instructions when using chemicals?
Are dilution ratios followed correctly?
Are substances only used for their intended purpose?
Are service users prevented from accessing hazardous substances during use?
Is appropriate PPE available for all tasks involving hazardous substances?
Is PPE in good condition and replaced when needed?
Are staff trained in correct PPE use?
Is PPE stored hygienically and correctly?
Are spill kits available and accessible?
Are staff trained in spill response procedures?
Are emergency contact numbers displayed clearly?
Are first aid kits available and fully stocked?
Are hazardous waste materials disposed of correctly?
Are clinical waste bins available where required?
Are waste containers labelled and used appropriately?
Are service users protected from exposure to hazardous substances?
Are risk assessments in place for service users with specific vulnerabilities (e.g., cognitive impairment)?
Are staff aware of individual service user risks relating to chemicals?
Are COSHH records maintained and up to date?
Are incident reports completed for any chemical-related accidents?
Are corrective actions documented and followed up?
Are there any outstanding actions from previous audits?
Have all actions been completed within agreed timescales?
